scripts.lint: npm run lint:lines && npm run lint:web && npm run lint:architecture && npm run lint:duplicates && npm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:architecture: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs src && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test architecture
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:rust
